As the feast begins, a recording crackles from ancient speakers

After a moment, the guests recognise {d_s(Host)} voice: fragments of other recordings, roughly spliced.

"I am... the greatest... failure... of our times..."

The crowd explode into laughter. {D(Host)} glower{s(Host)}; whoever arranged this stunt was all too ready to embarrass {him(Host)}.

We don't need that to impress our guests
Missed opportunity to examine ancient technology
As a social butterfly, you feel right at home in a feast
{D(Character)} flit{s(Character)} from group to group, the picture of geniality at the feast
"It's a pleasure to be here, truly."
{D(Character)} strut{s(Character)} through the gathering as though {he(Character)} were the true host
You loiter, unnoticed, at the edge of the feast. The perfect opportunity to slip away, and...
In the middle of the feast, an alarm wails; the guests rush to the escape shuttles
The colony's life support was sabotaged and will take days to repair. One of the guests is to blame - but which one?
Do not abuse your host's hospitality
If you are caught you will learn no secrets, and commit a crime against your host
{D_s(Host)} guards escort {d(Character)} into the feast hall, their expressions tense
"We caught {Character} rifling through a file system. A top secret file system."
You leave the ruckus of the feast and slip into the darker passageways
A server here, a cabinet there: no hiding place is safe from your pilfering.
But though you leave no server untapped, no databank secure, {d(Host)} seems to have no secrets to hide.
{D(Character)} enjoyed the feast a little too heartily
{His(Character)} head - and {his(Character)} status - will be the worse for wear tomorrow.
{D(Character)} is sticking {his(Character)} nose into all the feast preparations

"The color of the tables simply doesn't match the decorations. And you've completely blocked access to the kitchens! Give me a hand, let's move these chairs."

{Dis(Organizer)} not amused.
"How dare you invite that smug bit of flotsam!"
{Dhas(Character)} launched into a tirade, accusing {d(HatedChar)} of a host of slights. {HostingHouse}'s security deftly interpose, but a tension lingers throughout the festivities.
{Character} insulted {HatedChar} in the middle of {Host}'s feast, ruining the mood
Looking over the accounts after the feast, the figures don't tally
A sizable sum is missing: secretly siphoned from the budget. Only your own house members had access to those accounts.
Own House member stole from me
{D(Sec)} stands to attention. "I've heard troubling security reports, my {title(Host)}, over the last few days."
"I believe your life may be in danger at the upcoming gathering. At the very least we should increase security."
The moment the guests step off their shuttles, {d(Sec)} informs them the event is cancelled
{D(Attacker)} finishes {his(Attacker)} wine, smiles at you, and lets loose a booming cry: "Now!"
{His(Attacker)} retainers pull throwing knives and sidearms from beneath their cloaks. The banquet hall erupts in blood and screams.
Desperate and taken by surprise, your security team attempt to hold the line
Your men are well-trained: the assassins falter, and retreat. You and {Attacker} lock eyes as the door of {his(Attacker)} shuttle hisses closed.

Your men are cut down as they dive for cover - wiped out in seconds. {Attacker} saunters toward you, stands over you and aims a pistol at your forehead. {His(Attacker)} grin is the last thing you see.
You are on edge all night, waiting for a knife in the back.
But the blow never falls. A false alarm?
